newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS LAND WINS SINGAPORE LAND TENDER.
newsitem.headline: DBS LAND WINS SINGAPORE LAND TENDER.

text.p: DBS Land Ltd said on Thursday it had won a tender to develop a prime office project in Singapore at Singapore $118.19 million.
It said in a statement the tender, won by its wholly-owned subsidiary China Square Holdings Pte Ltd (CSH), is to develop an office project at Church Street, in the city.
The project is a joint venture with the land owner Chinese Chamber Realty Pte Ltd (CCR), a subsidiary of the Singapore Chinese Chamber of Commerce and Industry.
DBS said its winning bid represented a land price of S$9,150 per square metre per plot ratio for the 999-year leasehold site.
Provisional planning approval has been granted for a 20-storey office building with a total gross floor area of 25,820 square metre.
CSH and CCR will each own half of the building with the former taking the lower half.
